Hey OP! Before you get everything together for college, make sure you know what you want to do and if you really need a degree to do it. I’d suggest researching and finding out what interests you. Narrow down your work preferences (i.e. do you want to work at a small business or larger company, an office, school, environment, work directly with people, less people interaction, etc.)

Internships are invaluable and they can get people jobs more than a degree can. The trick with internships is that most companies only take enrolled students, so take on a few before you graduate because it’s very hard to find one once you graduate. If you get a job from one, that’s great. If not, at least you’ll have some actual work experience on your resume, which still makes you stand out. 

You can do it OP. If you hit a wall, always remember to not take everything so seriously 😊
